title.en: An outfield that couldn't hit it out

text.en: The outfield's OPS was close to average, but its 41 home runs tied for 29th of 30 clubs. DH was an even bigger hole.
text.zh-TW: 外野 OPS 接近平均，但只打 41 轟，30 隊並列第 29。DH 的洞更深。

title.en: The 20-homer bats were on the IL
title.zh-TW: 能打 20 轟的人，都在傷兵名單

text.en: No Jays outfielder hit more than 10 home runs. The two who can, Santander (44 in 2024) and Barger (21 in 2025), barely played in 2026.
text.zh-TW: 沒有一位藍鳥外野手超過 10 轟。有這個能力的 Santander（2024 年 44 轟）和 Barger（2025 年 21 轟），2026 年幾乎都沒上場。

label.en: Most HR by a Jays outfielder (Lukes)

title.en: Three bats that change a lineup

text.en: Only three free-agent outfielders can fill the 20-homer gap on their own: two steady 32-year-olds and an unknown from Japan.
text.zh-TW: 自由市場上只有三位外野手能直接補上 20 轟的缺口：兩位 32 歲的穩定強打，和一位日本職棒的未知數。

title.en: Cheaper bats, and the Jays' glove habit
title.zh-TW: 便宜選項，和藍鳥的守備偏好

text.en: Bauers and Grichuk can hit, but the Jays' team OAA has ranked in the top 12 five years running, so weak gloves look more like DHs here.
text.zh-TW: Bauers 和 Grichuk 都能打，但藍鳥的球隊 OAA 連五季都在前 12 名，守備差的人在這裡比較像 DH。

title.en: The farm: depth, not a slugger

text.en: The closest outfield prospects are on-base types, and the best tools (Jake Cook's 80-grade speed) are still in Single-A. Bateman is already up.
text.zh-TW: 最接近大聯盟的外野新秀都是上壘型，工具最好的 Jake Cook（80 分跑速）還在 Single-A。Bateman 已經上來了。

text.en: The CBA expires December 1 and most reports expect a lockout, which would freeze signings and trades. The big deals will likely land before it.
text.zh-TW: 勞資協議 12/1 到期，多數報導預期會停擺，簽約和交易都會凍結。大型簽約很可能都擠在這之前。

title.en: My take: one big deal, then wait
title.zh-TW: 我的想法：最多一張大合約

text.en: One big contract at most, and I think Suzuki fits best. Give center to Bateman and Straw, wait on Barger and Santander, and let the farm supply the depth.
text.zh-TW: 最多一張大合約，我認為 Suzuki 最適合；中外野交給 Bateman 和 Straw，再等 Barger、Santander 回歸，深度交給農場。
